A corner of Jin Bazar
that smells like dough

KabirBrewCafe started as a simple idea — a place where the warmth of a wood-fired oven meets the quiet comfort of a neighbourhood coffee counter. No frills, no fuss. Just properly made pizza, strong coffee, and margaritas that taste like summer.

Tucked away in Jin Bazar, Netrang, the cafe has become the kind of spot where regulars know the staff by name. The garlic bread comes out golden, the Four Cheese pizza has a loyal following, and the espresso machine runs from 11 AM until the last customer leaves.

“The kind of place you walk into for a coffee
and stay for two margaritas and a pizza.”
— regular since 2023

Little things that add up

Open 11 AM to 10 PM

Walk in any day. No reservations needed — just show up and we'll find you a seat.

Delivery & takeaway

Call ahead and we'll have your order bagged and ready. Delivery within Netrang — just ask.

Outdoor seating available

A small courtyard out back where you can sit under the sky with your coffee or margarita.

Card payments accepted

UPI, cards, and cash. Whatever works for you. No minimum order for card payments.

Clean & hygienic

Open kitchen, visible prep. We take hygiene seriously — you can see your food being made.

Booking for groups

Planning a get-together? Call ahead and we'll set up the back section for your group.
